pages.title: Laplace's Demon
pages.text: An intellect that knows every force and every position. Shown a machine, it knows exactly how the machine must be run.

$(thing)Creative mode only$(). Use it on a multiblock controller: it tunes the machine for the recipe its inputs match (or hold a recipe's product in your off hand to choose one) - every control, the coolant, containment and drift. For pack makers and testers.
